services.name: Sternwheel Festival One Hour Sightseeing on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 1 Hour About Perhaps one of our most popular weekends of the year is our Sternwheel Festival. Sternwheel boats from all over the region come in for the festival, but the Valley Gem is the only one that takes you out onto the river. On Saturday, September 6, we will have three one hour sightseeing cruises at 1:30pm, 3pm, 4:30pm. Enjoy a cruise past all the sternwheel boats that are in for the festival. Reservations are heavily recommended because the boats do sell out. $12 for Adults, $10 for Seniors, $5 for Children

services.name: Cruisin' with Santa on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 1 Hour About Come have breakfast and cruise the river with Santa Clause. On Saturday, December 6 and 13 at 10am, Santa Clause will be on board the Valley Gem. A breakfast will be served while you visit with Santa. Reservations are required. $20 for Adults, $18 for Seniors, $10 for Children

services.name: Polar Express Cruise on the Major Riviera
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Bring the kiddos and dive into a world of the Polar Express where hot chocolate is plentiful and everyone can hear the bell ring. Christmas desserts will surely make everyone smile. Our good friend, Santa, will be doing a reading of the Polar Express for the kids. Reservations are required. November 29, December 6, 2pm to 4pm $22 for Adults, $20 for Seniors, $12 for Children

services.name: Lock Tour on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 3 Hours About Marietta's unique location allows the Valley Gem to offer a lock tours through the hand operated system on the Muskingum River. On this tour, we will go through lock #2 at Devol's Dam. The Portside Café will be open on the boat throughout the trip if you wish to purchase refreshments. You can also pre-order a bag lunch that will be ready when you arrive. Reservations are recommended. July 5, 12, 19, 26, August 2, 9, 16, 23, 30, October 1, 8, 15, 22 $23 for Adults, $21 for Seniors, $13 for Children

services.name: Elf Cruise
services.desc: Celebrate the holidays with us and Buddy the Elf. Look for a visit from Santa as well. We will have luncheon cruise on the Valley Gem, along with songs, games, crafts, a reading of the book and time to visit with Buddy and Santa. Reservations are required. November 29, 11am to 1pm December 7, 12:30-2:30pm $36 for Adults, $34 for Seniors, $26 for Children

services.name: Grinch CRUISE
services.desc: Come and celebrate Christmas with the Grinch on the Major/Riviera. Watch for the Grinch, Max and Cindy Lou Who to make an appearance. The two hour cruise will begin with a luncheon, followed by games, crafts, a reading of The Grinch, and time to spend with our guests of honor. The Grinch cruise will be Saturday, December 6, and December 20, from 1pm to 3pm. Reservations are required. $36 for Adults, $34 for Seniors, $26 for Children

services.name: Sternwheel Lunch Cruise on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Perhaps one of our most popular weekends of the year is our Sternwheel Festival. Sternwheel boats from all over the region come in for the festival, but the Valley Gem is the only one that takes you out onto the river. On Saturday, September 6 from 11am-1pm we will offer a Lunch Cruise. Reservations book quickly for these events. Book your seats early! $40 for Adults, $38 for Seniors, $30 for Children

services.name: Sternwheel Festival Kick Off Luncheon on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About This two hour cruise will take you up the Ohio River and a lovely lunch will be served while underway. You will have the opportunity to see the boat in for the festival from the river. Don't miss this first event of the Sternwheel Festival from 11am to 1pm on Friday, September 5, 2024. Reservations are required. $40 for Adults, $38 for Seniors, $30 for Children

services.name: Pirate Dinner Cruise on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Ahoy! Dress in your best pirate costume and cruise with us on the Valley Gem. Enjoy this Halloween themed event with games, songs, crafts and a delicious pirate inspired dinner. (Costumes are encouraged but optional.) Fun for the whole family! Reservations are required. October 24, 6pm-8pm $40 for Adults, $38 for Seniors, $30 for Children

services.name: Holiday Movie Trivia on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Gather your friends and family and create your best trivia team. Enjoy a delicious dinner buffet followed by a live game of Holiday Movie Trivia. This will be a fun filled opportunity to celebrate. Winning team gets a prize basket. Join us for this fun holiday event. This event takes place on the both the Valley Gem and Major/Riviera. Valley Gem: December 4, 6pm-8pm $42 for Adults, $40 for Seniors, $32 for Children

services.name: Friendsgiving Cruise on the Valley Gem
services.desc: This Thanksgiving, take time to celebrate with Friends and enjoy our first ever Friendsgiving Dinner Cruise. This two hour dinner cruise will feature item that you might find at your very own Friendsgiving. Watch for more menu information much closer to the date. Don't miss out on this fun event. Call your friends now! Friday, November 21 from 6pm to 8pm $42 for Adults, $40 for Seniors, $32 for Children

services.name: MARIETTA: Independence Day Dinner Cruise
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Join us for a lovely July 4th evening Dinner Cruise from 6pm to 8pm. Enjoy a delicious dinner buffet with live entertainment from Steve and Beverly Pottmeyer on the upper deck (weather permitting). We will end the evening at 8pm so you can enjoy your favorite fireworks display. Reservations are required. $46 for Adults, $44 for Seniors, $36 for Children

services.name: Father's Day Cruise on the Valley Gem
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Celebrate Father's Day with our family at the Valley Gem! Fathers and their guests will enjoy a Captain's Buffet that every Dad is sure to love. This year's cruise is on June 16th from 1pm- 3pm. Reservations are required. Our Father's Day Cruise is available on the Valley Gem and Major/Riviera. $46 for Adults, $44 for Seniors, $36 for Children

services.name: Jazz on the River
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About We are excited to add some Jazz to our lives with our Jazz on the River cruises. We will be serving a delicious dinner buffet followed by live jazz music on the upper deck (weather permitting). April 25, 6pm to 8pm (Valley Gem) July 2, 6pm to 8pm (Major/Riviera) September 26, 6pm to 8pm (Valley Gem) $46 for Adults, $44 for Seniors, $36 for Children

Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone or email to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
